project_list_timeouts.classification: Evaluator navigation prerequisite assumption, with timing-sensitive premature view-read; no additional confirmed frontend product cause from raw timeout alone.
project_list_timeouts.mechanism: login() unconditionally waits overview project-list after identity. App restores an authorized saved per-user project/tab even after fresh login. Identity is rendered before project load settles, briefly exposing overview before restored detail; evaluator can catch transient overview or wait after it disappears.
project_list_timeouts.contract_interpretation: BRIEF permits SPA/multipage and coherent persisted selection, requires overview and functioning back-projects, but does not require every login to discard saved selection and settle on overview.
project_list_timeouts.uncertainty: No fresh execution here. Exact scheduling of each timeout unknown. Visibility of identity is not guaranteed completed project loading. Do not claim confirmed auth leak, login failure, persistence loss or additional defects.

activity_assertion.classification: Dependent group cascade / prerequisite writes absent, not confirmed stored-event loss.
activity_assertion.mechanism: Groups share page/context/database. Earlier comment and decision groups enter login first and abort on missing overview before submission. Staff publication then requires comment_added, decision_submitted and revision_published, although those predecessor writes never ran.
activity_assertion.uncertainty: Actual failing event set not preserved in raw report; exact per-event absence unknown, but independence of six bug claims is unsupported.
